name: bg-bakery
prompt: Generate an image. These are characters from my 2D side-view platformer set in a giant cosy kitchen. I need the BACKGROUND WALL for the BAKERY levels, in the same soft chunky cartoon game art style (clean outlines, warm saturated colours, soft shading). Straight-on side view of a warm bakery wall: rustic cream plaster and warm red brick, a big arched brick bread oven glowing softly orange, wooden racks full of golden loaves, croissants and baguettes, hanging wooden paddles and rolling pins, a flour sack. Keep it calm and slightly soft so characters in front stand out. IMPORTANT: no counter, no floor, nothing at the bottom, no characters, no text. Wide 16:9 landscape image.
